title: Onchain Sokoban
tagline: Fully Onchain Sokoban classic puzzle game built using MUD Framework
description: Onchain Sokoban is a classic puzzle game in which the player has to push boxes or crates onto specific targets in a warehouse or storage room. The objective is to move the boxes strategically, without getting them stuck in corners or against walls, to reach the designated targets.
how_its_made: Onchain Sokoban is a classic puzzle game built using the emojimon starter template provided by mud.dev tutorial here https://mud.dev/tutorials/emojimon/getting-started with necessary modifications and deployed contracts locally using foundry used  reactjs   as a part of frontend
